reasons.plausibility: Using ML-trained interatomic potentials to approximate ab initio free energies is scientifically sound and aligns with ongoing developments, though success hinges on adequate training data and careful validation of complex high-entropy systems.
reasons.testability: They specify clear, quantitative benchmarks (free-energy errors relative to full ab initio MD), making it straightforward to test and potentially falsify.
reasons.usefulness: If it works, this approach could drastically reduce cost and enable detailed thermodynamic analyses of high-entropy alloys, offering significant practical benefit to researchers.
